add_noise_to_audio_signal: mix a 16-bit audio signal with noise at a specified SNR level using add_noise
load_av_hubert_models: load AV-HuBERT model ensembles from a directory using load_av_models for inference
infer_with_av_hubert: run AV-HuBERT inference on a video and audio pair using infer_av_hubert
interpolate_face_landmarks: interpolate missing face landmarks across video frames using landmarks_interpolate
mix_webcam_audio_with_noise: extract audio from a webcam video and mix it with noise using mix_audio_with_noise
